send_message: send a text or interactive card message to a Feishu user or chat via open_id or chat_id
update_message: update an existing Feishu message with new markdown card content using a message_id
handle_message: handle an incoming Feishu message by parsing content, downloading media, and running the agent
handle_command: process a Feishu slash command such as /stop, /new, /help, /status, /restore, or /continue
build_feishu_agent_server: build a Feishu WebSocket agent server that receives messages and runs an AI agent in the background
